name: obsidian-editor-defaults-archit
description: Enforces vault defaults on every device, on load and whenever they drift: links use the full path from the vault root without a |alias, attachments go to one folder, deleted files go to the Obsidian trash, core plugins and hotkeys are set, and date properties show as YYYY-MM-DD.
author: Archit Gupta

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
